lines.zh: 我在菌丝水草间滑行，红得像菌盖。
lines.en: I slip through mycelium weeds, red as a mushroom cap.

lines.zh: 蘑菇岛的浅水里，我慢慢巡游。
lines.en: In the shallows of the mushroom island, I cruise slowly.

lines.zh: 八条同族排开，像一片菌伞。
lines.en: Eight of us spread out like a field of caps.

lines.zh: 孢子落进水里，我张嘴接。
lines.en: Spores drift down; I open my mouth to catch them.

lines.zh: 我的背是红的，肚子是白的。
lines.en: My back is red, my belly pale.

lines.zh: 菌丝缠住我的尾，我一摆就断。
lines.en: Mycelium snags my tail; one flick and it tears.

lines.zh: 我绕着巨型蘑菇转圈。
lines.en: I circle the giant mushroom's stem.

lines.zh: 水底的菌毯软得像云。
lines.en: The mycelium carpet below is soft as cloud.

lines.zh: 越靠近菌盖，水越暖。
lines.en: The nearer the cap, the warmer the water.

lines.zh: 我游过的地方，孢子还浮着。
lines.en: Spores still float where I have passed.

lines.zh: 红白相间，谁都能认出我。
lines.en: Red and white—anyone would know me.

lines.zh: 浅滩的菌影跟着我走。
lines.en: The mushroom's shadow walks with me across the shallows.

lines.zh: 我贴着水底，找掉下来的菌丝。
lines.en: I hug the bottom, hunting fallen mycelium.

lines.zh: 这片水域全是菌子的味道。
lines.en: These waters taste entirely of fungus.

lines.zh: 我绕着一圈小蘑菇游，怕碰倒它们。
lines.en: I circle a ring of small mushrooms, careful not to topple them.

lines.zh: 我穿过菌丝拱门，红影一晃。
lines.en: I pass through a mycelium arch, a flicker of red.

lines.zh: 我在浅水边停一下，晒背上的红。
lines.en: I pause at the shallows to sun the red on my back.

lines.zh: 潮水推着孢子走，我顺着跟。
lines.en: The tide carries spores; I drift along behind them.

lines.zh: 我停在一朵菇下，慢慢摆尾。
lines.en: I rest under a cap, tail barely moving.

lines.zh: 孢子围着我打转，我不赶它们。
lines.en: Spores circle me; I do not shoo them off.

lines.zh: 水太静，我的红斑也就暗了。
lines.en: The water is so still my red patches dim.

lines.zh: 八条鱼挤在菌影里打盹。
lines.en: Eight of us doze in a mushroom's shadow.

lines.zh: 我吐一口气，吹散一小撮孢子。
lines.en: I breathe out and scatter a puff of spores.

lines.zh: 菌毯上有一块凹陷，正好容我。
lines.en: There is a hollow in the mycelium that fits me.

lines.zh: 这里没人下钩，我安心。
lines.en: No one fishes here; I am at ease.

lines.zh: 我慢慢咀嚼一片菌丝。
lines.en: I chew a strand of mycelium slowly.

lines.zh: 红盖在头顶，白点在水里。
lines.en: Red caps overhead, white spots in the water.

lines.zh: 连影子都是淡红的。
lines.en: Even my shadow is a pale red.

lines.zh: 我一半在睡，一半在听水。
lines.en: Half of me sleeps; half listens to the water.

lines.zh: 水底的菌丝在悄悄长。
lines.en: The mycelium below grows quietly.

lines.zh: 这片水域从没被翻过底。
lines.en: These waters have never been dredged.

lines.zh: 我懒得游，菌子就在旁边。
lines.en: Why swim? The fungus is right here.

lines.zh: 你踩进菌水里，我抬眼看你。
lines.en: You step into the fungus water, and I look up.

lines.zh: 你的靴上沾了菌丝和水。
lines.en: Mycelium and water cling to your boots.

lines.zh: 我不要你的东西，只要你别踩菌毯。
lines.en: I want nothing from you but your feet off the mycelium.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道，不像这座岛。
lines.en: You smell like nothing from this island.

lines.zh: 我转过来，红盖正对你。
lines.en: I turn, and my red cap faces you.

lines.zh: 你弯下腰，我反倒升了半尺。
lines.en: You bend low, and I rise half a foot.

lines.zh: 这座岛上，鱼比人常见。
lines.en: On this island, fish are commoner than people.

lines.zh: 那只桶，我见过它装走同族。
lines.en: That bucket has carried off my kin before.

lines.zh: 你不动，我便贴到脚边。
lines.en: If you hold still, I will come to your feet.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在菌盖上，光暗了。
lines.en: Your shadow falls on the cap, and the light dims.

lines.zh: 我的红斑被打散了，颜色乱掉。
lines.en: My red patches scatter, colors running wild.

lines.zh: 菌丝被血染成暗红。
lines.en: Blood stains the mycelium dark red.

lines.zh: 我猛地一沉，扎进菌毯。
lines.en: I drop hard and burrow into the mycelium.

lines.zh: 痛得我把孢子全吐出来。
lines.en: The pain makes me cough out all my spores.

lines.zh: 这一点伤，菇水会治。
lines.en: The fungus water will mend this much.

lines.zh: 我躲进菌盖下的暗处。
lines.en: I hide in the dark beneath a cap.

lines.zh: 尾巴还在动，我就还活着。
lines.en: My tail still moves, so I am still alive.

lines.zh: 你打断了我的咀嚼。
lines.en: You interrupted my chewing.

lines.zh: 我的鳞薄，伤口却浅。
lines.en: My scales are thin, but the cut is shallow.

lines.zh: 我记住了你的靴子。
lines.en: I remember your boots.

lines.zh: 你手心的孢子团，味道很熟。
lines.en: The spore clump in your palm smells familiar.

lines.zh: 那不是菌丝，但我会试一口。
lines.en: That is not mycelium, but I will try one bite.

lines.zh: 红的东西，我都想咬咬看。
lines.en: Anything red, I want to bite.

lines.zh: 你撒的碎屑沉到菌毯上了。
lines.en: Your crumbs are sinking to the mycelium.

lines.zh: 我靠近了，尾巴摆得快。
lines.en: I come closer, my tailbeats quickening.

lines.zh: 水里飘来的味道，像蘑菇汤。
lines.en: The scent in the water is like mushroom soup.

lines.zh: 我张嘴，又停下想一想。
lines.en: I open my mouth, then pause to think.

lines.zh: 鱼也贪嘴，别只怪我。
lines.en: Fish are greedy too; do not blame only me.

lines.zh: 你的手指比菌柄好玩。
lines.en: Your fingertip is more interesting than a mushroom stem.

lines.zh: 我就尝一小口，不算上当。
lines.en: One small taste. That does not count as being fooled.

lines.zh: 你搅动菌水，把我推歪了。
lines.en: You stir the fungus water and shove me off course.

lines.zh: 我撞在你的靴上，菌丝粘住了。
lines.en: I bump your boot, and mycelium sticks to it.

lines.zh: 八条鱼挤着，只能互相撞。
lines.en: Eight of us crowded means constant bumping.

lines.zh: 你退开，我立刻回菌影里。
lines.en: You step back, and I return to the mushroom's shade.

lines.zh: 浅水太窄，你我都不好走。
lines.en: The shallows are too narrow for either of us.

lines.zh: 我贴着你绕过去，没生气。
lines.en: I slide around you, not angry.

lines.zh: 这一撞，把孢子全扬起来了。
lines.en: That bump threw up a whole cloud of spores.

lines.zh: 我的鳞滑，撞一下也不留痕。
lines.en: My scales are slick; a bump leaves no mark.

lines.zh: 同伴撞我，我让开半个身子。
lines.en: A companion bumps me and I yield half a body.

lines.zh: 水底的菌毯挡了我们两下。
lines.en: The mycelium below blocked us twice.

lines.zh: 两条红蕈鱼并排游，很配。
lines.en: Two red shrooma swimming abreast look well matched.

lines.zh: 我的红盖比它淡一点。
lines.en: My red cap runs paler than theirs.

lines.zh: 我们把卵放进菌丝丛里。
lines.en: We set our eggs among the mycelium stalks.

lines.zh: 在这座岛上，成双的不只我们。
lines.en: On this island we are not the only pair.

lines.zh: 我绕它转三圈，孢子跟着飞。
lines.en: I circle them three times, spores trailing after me.

lines.zh: 别靠太近，菌毯会被踩坏。
lines.en: Do not come closer; you will crush the mycelium.

lines.zh: 水里的红影叠成一个。
lines.en: Our red shadows overlap into one.

lines.zh: 产卵期不长，得快点。
lines.en: The spawning season is short; we must be quick.

lines.zh: 下一群还是红白相间。
lines.en: The next school will be red and white as well.

lines.zh: 我们在菇影下并排浮着。
lines.en: We float side by side beneath the mushroom's shadow.

lines.zh: 你捧起我，孢子沾了满手。
lines.en: You lift me, and spores coat your hands.

lines.zh: 我的红斑在你掌上蹭出淡痕。
lines.en: My red patches smear faint marks on your palm.

lines.zh: 离水之后，菌丝还缠在我尾上。
lines.en: Out of the water, mycelium still clings to my tail.

lines.zh: 别看我的肚子，它不像伞。
lines.en: Do not stare at my belly; it is nothing like a gill.

lines.zh: 菌子水很暖，你的手却凉。
lines.en: The fungus water is warm, your hands are cool.

lines.zh: 我拍了一下，孢子飞起来。
lines.en: I flap once, and spores fly.

lines.zh: 把我放回菌影里，好吗。
lines.en: Put me back under the cap, would you.

lines.zh: 水里的红，在岸上就暗了。
lines.en: The red that lives in water fades on land.

lines.zh: 我身上没毒，只是味道怪。
lines.en: I am not poisonous, only strange-tasting.

lines.zh: 我的手感，像一块湿菇。
lines.en: I feel like a wet mushroom in your grip.

lines.zh: 有东西在菌盖下动，我看见了。
lines.en: Something moves under a cap, and I see it.

lines.zh: 那点白影比孢子大得多。
lines.en: That pale flicker is far bigger than a spore.

lines.zh: 我先缩尾，再盯着它。
lines.en: I tuck my tail, then fix my gaze on it.

lines.zh: 菌水很浑，我靠味道判断。
lines.en: The fungus water is murky; I judge by scent.

lines.zh: 不是食物，那我也要看住。
lines.en: It may not be food, but I will watch it.

lines.zh: 八条同伴都转了头。
lines.en: All eight companions have turned their heads.

lines.zh: 它一动，我的鳃就停了一下。
lines.en: It moves, and my gills stop for a beat.

lines.zh: 这座岛上很少有这么大的东西。
lines.en: This island rarely sees anything so large.

lines.zh: 我浮起来，把它罩在影子里。
lines.en: I rise and let it fall into my shadow.

lines.zh: 先记住方位，再决定要不要碰它。
lines.en: I mark the direction first, then consider touching it.

lines.zh: 我贴着菌毯靠近，不出声。
lines.en: I creep along the mycelium without a sound.

lines.zh: 它踩碎了菌丝，我在数步子。
lines.en: It crushes mycelium, and I am counting steps.

lines.zh: 再近一点，我就能看清。
lines.en: One step closer and I will see it clearly.

lines.zh: 水下的孢子帮我遮了身形。
lines.en: Spores in the water help hide my shape.

lines.zh: 我绕到菌柄背面去。
lines.en: I work around to the far side of the stem.

lines.zh: 尾巴收着，只让鳃轻轻动。
lines.en: Tail tucked, only my gills stirring.

lines.zh: 它回头的瞬间，我悬住不动。
lines.en: The instant it looks back, I hang motionless.

lines.zh: 菌影够深，我不必急。
lines.en: The mushroom's shade is deep; I need not hurry.

lines.zh: 这一片水，我比它熟。
lines.en: I know these waters better than it does.

lines.zh: 红斑此刻闭着，当我不存在。
lines.en: My red patches are shut; pretend I am not here.

lines.zh: 我咬住它，又被菌丝缠了脚。
lines.en: I bite it, then mycelium tangles my fins.

lines.zh: 撞它一下，孢子扬了它一脸。
lines.en: I ram it, and spores burst across its face.

lines.zh: 我的牙短，只能一下一下咬。
lines.en: My teeth are short, so I bite again and again.

lines.zh: 它抓我，我的鳞滑脱了。
lines.en: It grabs me, and my slick scales slip free.

lines.zh: 菌水让我游得不快，但狠。
lines.en: Fungus water makes me slow, but mean.

lines.zh: 这一下，是为了我的菌毯。
lines.en: That one was for my mycelium carpet.

lines.zh: 我咬完就躲回菇影。
lines.en: The bite done, I hide beneath the cap.

lines.zh: 红蕈鱼的脾气和颜色一样冲。
lines.en: A red shrooma's temper runs as hot as its color.

lines.zh: 它怕孢子，我就多扬一些。
lines.en: It fears spores, so I stir up more.

lines.zh: 打不过，我就往下沉。
lines.en: If I cannot win, I sink.

lines.zh: 我在菌水里出生，一身红白。
lines.en: I am born in fungus water, red and white.

lines.zh: 蘑菇岛的浅滩认得我。
lines.en: The shallows of the mushroom island know me.

lines.zh: 四周都是菌盖，没有别的颜色。
lines.en: Caps all around, and no other color.

lines.zh: 八个同伴一起下水，挤得慌。
lines.en: Eight of us enter the water at once, crowded tight.

lines.zh: 我第一次摆尾，就撞上菌丝。
lines.en: My first tailbeat runs straight into mycelium.

lines.zh: 这里的水有股淡淡的菇味。
lines.en: The water here has a faint mushroom smell.

lines.zh: 我浮上浅滩，替自己占块菌影。
lines.en: I surface in the shallows and claim a patch of shadow.

lines.zh: 岛上没有别的鱼，只有我们。
lines.en: No other fish on this island—only us.

lines.zh: 我从孢子堆里钻出来。
lines.en: I come up out of a drift of spores.

lines.zh: 别踩下来，这里全是菌毯。
lines.en: Do not step here; this is all mycelium.

lines.zh: 火一燎，菌味全焦了。
lines.en: One lick of flame and the mushroom smell burns.

lines.zh: 摔在菌毯上，还算软。
lines.en: Dropped onto the mycelium, which is soft at least.

lines.zh: 离开菌水，我喘不上气。
lines.en: Out of the fungus water, I cannot breathe.

lines.zh: 炸得菌盖都翻了。
lines.en: The blast turned the mushroom caps over.

lines.zh: 箭穿过菌影，扎进我身上。
lines.en: An arrow crosses the cap's shadow and finds me.

lines.zh: 药水味压过了菌香。
lines.en: The potion's smell overpowers the fungus.

lines.zh: 饿得我去啃菌柄。
lines.en: Hungry enough to gnaw the mushroom stems.

lines.zh: 雷落在岛上，水都亮了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the island and the water lights up.

lines.zh: 没有菌，也没有水。
lines.en: No fungus here, and no water either.
